questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of on-the-job and off-the-job training methods
questions.solution_html:
• Evaluate the effectiveness of on-the-job and off-the-job training methods-[
  • Effectiveness of On-the-Job Training
  • a) Learning by doing improves practical skills quickly.
  • b) Provides real work experience in actual job conditions.
  • c) Cost-effective as no separate training infrastructure is needed.
  • d) Immediate application of knowledge enhances retention.
  • e) Builds confidence and job familiarity.
  • f) Encourages interaction with supervisors and peers.
  • g) Limitation: May lead to errors or reduced productivity during training.
  • h) Limitation: Quality depends on the trainer’s ability.
  • Effectiveness of Off-the-Job Training
  • a) Provides a structured and systematic learning environment.
  • b) Allows focus without workplace distractions.
  • c) Useful for theoretical knowledge and conceptual understanding.
  • d) Exposure to new ideas, techniques, and innovations.
  • e) Safer learning environment—no risk to actual operations.
  • f) Limitation: Higher cost and requires special facilities.
  • g) Limitation: Less opportunity for immediate practical application.
  • An] /

questions.final_answer: An]
